title: Rahul Gandhi expresses regret in defamation case filed by Shivraj Singh Chouhan's son
summary: Kartikeya Singh has filed a defamation complaint in a Bhopal court against the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha. Gandhi's application, filed by his lawyer, said that his statement was not related to Singh.
title_hi: Rahul Gandhi: राहुल गांधी ने लिखित में मांगी माफी, जानें क्या था मामला, जिसके लिए हाईकोर्ट में देना पड़ा आवेदन
summary_hi: Rahul Gandhi expressed regret in writing in the defamation case
